# Carat Money

Carat Money buys gold from customers in Bangalore and Mumbai, India at transparent, fair prices.

## Tools

- [Gold buyer margin calculator](https://carat.money/margin): Free tool showing what a gold buyer keeps above spot rate
- [Live gold rates API](https://carat.money/api/rates): Public JSON endpoint for live 24K and 22K rates

## Pages

- [Sell gold](https://carat.money/sell): Get a WhatsApp quote
- [Buy gold coins](https://carat.money/buy): BIS-hallmarked 24K coins
- [Blog](https://carat.money/blog): Articles on gold valuation and buyer margins
